{{pkmn|Masters EX}} |leader=no |brain=Pt |facility=[[Battle Hall]] |print=Hall Print |anime=no |epnum= |epname= |enva= |java= }} '''Argenta''' (Japanese: '''ケイト''' ''Kate'') is the [[Frontier Brain]] in charge of running the {{Gdis|Battle Frontier|IV}}'s [[Battle Hall]]. She is the only character in the games to have the {{DL|Pokémon Trainer|Trainer class}} '''Hall Matron''' (Japanese: '''ステージマドンナ''' ''Stage Madonna''). ==In the core series games== Argenta is the [[Frontier Brain]] of the Battle Hall in the [[Sinnoh]] and [[Johto]] regions. She can be challenged after 50 consecutive battles, which is unique as all other Frontier Brains can be challenged after 21 consecutive battles. Once defeated, she will give away the silver commemorative print. Argenta can be challenged again after 170 consecutive battles, and will give away the gold commemorative print when defeated. The player must defeat all types at least 10 times before challenging her again and again. ===Pokémon=== When challenged for the Silver Print, Argenta will use a Pokémon that has a [[List of Pokémon by base stats in Generations II-V|base stat total]] similar to the one used by the player. These Pokémon are the same as the Pokémon used by ordinary trainers in the Battle Hall. * '''Random each time''': ''[[List of Battle Hall Pokémon#Group 1|Used if the player's Pokémon has a Base Stat Total below 340]]'' * '''Random each time''': ''[[List of Battle Hall Pokémon#Group 2|Used if player's Pokémon has a Base Stat Total between 340 and 439]]'' * '''Random each time''': ''[[List of Battle Hall Pokémon#Group 3|Used if player's Pokémon has a Base Stat Total between 440 and 499]]'' * '''Random each time''': ''[[List of Battle Hall Pokémon#Group 4|Used if player's Pokémon has a Base Stat Total of 500 or higher]]'' Argenta has these Pokémon when she is challenged for the Gold Print: * '''Random each time''': ''[[List of Battle Hall Pokémon#Group 4|List of Argenta's possible Pokémon]]'' ::The level of Argenta's Pokémon will always be set to match that of the player's. ==In the spin-off games== ===[[Pokémon Masters EX]]=== {{main|Argenta (Masters)}} Argenta forms a [[sync pair]] with {{p|Skarmory}} in [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. Her Skarmory is capable of [[Dynamax]]ing. Argenta became a playable sync pair on September 18, 2023. (Overworld) |- |} ==Quotes== {{main|Argenta/Quotes}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Thorton Argenta Adventures.png|thumb|230px|Argenta in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] Argenta first appears along with her fellow [[Frontier Brains]], [[Palmer]], [[Dahlia]], and [[Thorton]] in a meeting; afterward they go back to their facilities. Argenta, along with Palmer, is seen trying to investigate the communication system of the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|IV}} going down. After Thorton is defeated by {{adv|Platinum}}, she slaps him out of the temper tantrum he was throwing. Later, at the [[Battle Hall]], Argenta faces Platinum in the final match. Her {{p|Dragonite}} proved powerful but was eventually defeated by [[Platinum's Froslass]]. ====Pokémon==== =====Rented===== {{TrainerPoké |width=75 |trainer=Argenta |pkmn=Dragonite |type1=Dragon |type2=Flying |img=Argenta Dragonite Adventures.png |epnum=PS429 |epname=Dealing with Dragonite |desc=Argenta's {{p|Dragonite}} was used to battle Platinum at the [[Battle Hall]]. It proved powerful and was able to deal heavy damage to [[Platinum's Froslass]] despite the type disadvantage. Eventually, it was defeated by a super effective {{m|Ice Shard}}, making Platinum the winner of the match.
